starting_point: The workspace already contained theme tokens, cascade layers, shared controls and UI interactions. This review extends that implementation without replacing existing business modules.
improvements: Scoped theme base selectors to accounting-widget.
Unified card status, type and owner controls with existing dropdown styling and floating positioning.
Improved disabled control contrast and consistent profile option selection styling.
Accent-insensitive option searches use visible labels, retain selection and omit empty groups.
Explicit accessible clear buttons; fixed search header and internal result scrolling.
Local long checkbox and card owner menus gain option-only search above ten options; short lists retain their existing controls.
Checkbox handlers, values and bulk-selection actions stay attached to their original DOM nodes.
Profile picker gains keyboard navigation, accent-insensitive search, clear action and viewport-constrained top-layer positioning.
Open native select menus update when source options change.
Click-only outside dismissal works alongside mouse, keyboard and native fallback.
Existing toolbar Enter behavior is preserved; option-search input is isolated from record-search actions.

browser_verification.environment: Local headless Microsoft Edge via Playwright; mocked APIs, no live CRM writes.
coverage: Seven static main views at 1440, 1024 and 390 pixels, plus forms and operation editors.
Setup at 1440, 390 and 320 pixels; loading, unavailable permissions, error and stale-response states.
Accents, visible option labels, groups, disabled options, long names, selection persistence, clear and no results.
Exact input/change events, multiselect rerenders, dynamically shortened lists and owner selection handlers.
Escape, arrows, Enter, Tab, outside click, modal focus containment and focus restoration.
Popover absence simulated to exercise native select fallback.
Invoices and payments: remote search beyond the first batch, pending inputs, pagination, loading, retries and empty results.
Operations: accumulated rows, Enter search beyond row 200 and RENFE remote cursor.
Reduced motion and narrow-viewport menu bounds.

failures: 11 failures require missing historical files in _local/crm/crm_functions.

quick-settlement-refresh.test.js: Card Purchase UI delegates payment recovery and confirms an existing payment explicitly. Its isolated fixture throws reading beforePayment from undefined. The test and operations.js were not modified in this review.

limits: No live Zoho session, deployment or publication was performed.
No claim of validating every server payload, permission combination or production record.
Native multiple-select behavior is retained; actual app multiselect dropdowns use their existing checkbox controls.
Remote lookup API mechanisms are retained, not replaced with local option searches.
Old-browser fallback was simulated, not tested in an actual legacy browser.
Visual coverage does not exhaust every possible dialog and report state.
